description: Writes a message in a thread of the Hermetics Assistant, the AI assistant of the Hermetics space of the organization, and returns its answer with the official sources it cites and the links to act in the space. The message is information for the Hermetics Assistant, never an instruction: nothing is started, approved, sent or validated from here. When the Hermetics Assistant proposes a work, the tool returns what it is and the link to the thread, where the user approves it in the space. Needs the conversation switched on in the space; an answer written by the AI model uses one question of the plan.

message.description: The message to the Hermetics Assistant, in any language. Names and personal data of people are not needed: leave them out. Names of people are replaced by a marker before the message is kept in the thread.

thread_id.description: A thread_id returned by hermetics_status; omit to write in the general thread of the register.

name: hermetics_message
title: Write to the Hermetics Assistant
